verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs claim federated identity support for custom SAML and OIDC apps (rippling-it-docs-4), satisfying part of the story, but there's no evidence of header-based app SSO support or any documented step-by-step walkthroughs for configuring these custom apps. Missing for 10: header-based auth app support, actual walkthrough/tutorial content showing SAML/OIDC custom app setup steps, independent corroboration of ease-of-use.
